about: The postcommunio of the formulary “Exaltation of the Holy Cross” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: Stand by us, O Lord our God, and also defend, with the unceasing aid of the holy Cross, those whom You make rejoice in its honor. Through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, forever and ever.
